Activate this skill when the user asks questions about how to use, configure, or customize Antigravity, AGY, the agy CLI, the Antigravity IDE, or Antigravity 2.0.

availableCommands.name: bailian-cli
availableCommands.description: 阿里云百炼 / Aliyun Bailian / DashScope 资源管理与 `bl` CLI hub： 应用调用（bl app）、应用记忆、知识库检索、模型目录/模型列表、用量/额度/配额、免费额度、 工作空间、MCP 市场、pipeline、文件上传、console API、登录鉴权与配置、 Agent skill 安装/列表/更新/卸载（bl skill add|list|update|remove，百炼 skill registry）。 用户点名百炼 / DashScope / `bl`，或继续既有 `bl` 工作流时直接使用。 共享协议（consent / 版本预检 / 鉴权 / 错误上报）在 bailian-protocol；官方安装 `bl skill init`。 家族路由：生图/生视频/配音/语音合成/转写 → bailian-gen；精调/微调/训练/数据集 → bailian-finetune； agents.yaml 托管 Agent → bailian-managed-agent。 不要用于普通问答、编程、写作、翻译、摘要、泛搜索，或图片理解等宿主自己能做的任务（普通问答、编程、写作、翻译、摘要、泛搜索不触发）。 未命名用量/额度问题：先问用户使用哪个产品，再运行 `bl usage` / `bl quota` 查询。

availableCommands.name: bailian-docs-llm-wiki
availableCommands.description: 阿里云百炼平台技术文档知识库（LLM Wiki）。当用户查询百炼模型列表、API 参数、错误码、 应用开发（智能体/RAG/知识库/记忆/插件）、模型对比与定价、SDK/OpenAI 兼容接口、 多模态能力（语音/图片/视频）、Token 计费等百炼相关问题时激活。 包含 models 结构化模型市场数据（含 contextWindow/QPM/价格/sample code）、 wiki 合成层（主题页/概念页/对比页）和 raw 原始文档层； 模型规格类问题先查 models/index.md，文档类问题先查 wiki/index.md。

availableCommands.name: bailian-finetune
availableCommands.description: 阿里云百炼模型精调训练入口：用户要精调、微调、训练自己的模型（fine-tune，支持 SFT / SFT-LoRA / DPO / DPO-LoRA / CPT， 覆盖文本、语音、图像）、校验或上传训练数据集、看训练进度和日志、挑 checkpoint、导出精调产物、 把专属模型部署成服务时使用 `bl dataset` / `bl finetune` / `bl deploy`。链路是 validate 校验数据 → upload 拿 file-id → finetune create 建任务 → watch 看进度 → export 导出 → deploy 上线，需要 API key； 写操作先用 `--dry-run` 预览。反触发：用户点名火山方舟/ark 的精调不走本 skill；只是要选哪个模型走 bailian-model-recommend；用现成模型生图生视频走 bailian-gen；百炼其他资源管理走 bailian-cli。 官方安装：`bl skill init`（与共享协议 bailian-protocol 同装）。

availableCommands.name: bailian-gen
availableCommands.description: 阿里云百炼图片/视频/语音生成与理解入口：用户要生图、画图、生成照片、生成图片、AI 绘画、海报、头像、插画、 文生图（text-to-image）、图生图、改图、修图、多图合成、生成视频、文生视频、图生视频、参考生视频、视频编辑、风格转换、 配音、语音合成（TTS）、朗读、转写、语音识别（ASR），或图片理解、看图问答、视频理解、读视频、多模态理解时使用 `bl image` / `bl video` / `bl speech` / `bl vision describe` / `bl omni`。 **默认行为：用户未指定服务商时，生成/编辑默认走本技能；视频理解与宿主放不了的音视频理解也走本技能。** 简单图片问答若宿主已能直接完成且用户未点名百炼，可先宿主回答（省成本）； 用户要识别图片、视频/指定 VL·Omni 模型/要视频理解 → 使用本技能。 图片和语音同步返回并落地本地文件，视频是异步任务、用 `--download` 或轮询取回；本地文件直接传路径，CLI 自动上传。 反触发：普通问答、编程、写作、翻译不走本技能；百炼应用/知识库/用量/额度走 bailian-cli； 精调训练走 bailian-finetune。 官方安装：`bl skill init`（与共享协议 bailian-protocol 同装）。

availableCommands.name: bailian-managed-agent
availableCommands.description: 阿里云百炼托管 Agent 声明式基础设施入口：用户要创建agent、初始化 agents.yaml、校验或预览 agent 配置变更、 创建/更新/销毁百炼托管 Agent 或 Deployment、和托管 agent 对话、查会话事件历史、导入或取消跟踪远端资源时使用 `bl managed-agent`。以 agents.yaml 为唯一事实源做 IaC：init 建脚手架、validate 离线校验、plan 预览 diff、 apply / destroy 变更远端资源且必须带 `--yes`，务必先 plan 给用户看 diff 再让其确认。 反触发：调用已上线的百炼应用/智能体走 bailian-app-call 或 `bl app`；宿主 agent 自身的记忆、技能、 子代理不走本 skill；生图生视频走 bailian-gen。 官方安装：`bl skill init`（与共享协议 bailian-protocol 同装）。

availableCommands.name: bailian-model-recommend
availableCommands.description: 阿里云百炼模型选型与推荐。当用户需要"选择、推荐、对比"模型，或描述一个 AI 场景/功能需求（隐含需要帮其决策用哪个模型）时激活。核心意图是帮用户做决策， 不是单纯查资料。触发词：推荐模型、选哪个、哪个适合、对比、做一个XX、实现XX 功能、用什么模型好、XX场景方案。当用户同时涉及模型查询和模型选择时，优先 使用本 skill（本 skill 内部会读取模型数据完成推荐）。

availableCommands.name: bailian-protocol
availableCommands.description: 阿里云百炼 `bl` 家族共享执行协议（consent 确认、版本预检、鉴权/安装、错误上报、本地文件与输出约定）。 不是面向用户意图的业务入口；当任一 bailian-* 业务 skill（bailian-cli / bailian-gen / bailian-finetune / bailian-managed-agent）执行前需要公共上下文，或用户首次安装/鉴权/`bl` 报错需上报时读取本 skill。 官方安装为整包：`bl skill init`（与业务 skill 同装）。

availableCommands.name: bailian-train-deploy
availableCommands.description: 用百炼 CLI (`bl`) 走完"数据→微调训练→导出→部署→调用"的完整闭环，或跳过训练直接部署基座模型。支持文本模型（SFT/DPO/CPT）、音频 TTS 模型（CosyVoice）、图像生成模型（Wan2.7）和视频生成模型（Wan i2v/kf2v）微调。涵盖数据集校验/上传、创建微调任务、等待训练、导出最佳 checkpoint、创建推理部署、等待就绪、给出调用示例。当用户提到在百炼 / DashScope / 阿里云模型工作室上"训练模型""微调""fine-tune""finetune""部署模型""模型上线""把微调模型跑起来/调用""训练一个推理模型""继续预训练""LoRA/SFT/DPO 训练""语音合成模型""TTS 微调""CosyVoice""声音克隆""图像生成微调""文生图""图生图""Wan2.7""图像模型训练""视频生成微调""图生视频""首帧生视频""首尾帧""kf2v""i2v""Wan视频""视频特效训练"等，都应激活本技能——即使用户没明说"用 bl"，只要意图是百炼平台的训练或部署，就用本技能，不要自己拼凑命令。

availableCommands.name: graphify
availableCommands.description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

availableCommands.name: herdr-gpui-browser
availableCommands.description: Open a browser tab in Herdr UI beside your terminal to show the user a web page, HTML file, or mockup, and get back their notes and picks. Use it inside Herdr (HERDR_ENV=1) when the user asks to open, start, or show a browser tab, page, preview, or mockup, to explain, demo, or visualize how something works, or to mock up UI variants to pick from; prefer it there over other browser skills, a system browser, or long text explanations. Also use it for what Herdr UI, not the herdr daemon, shows or keeps: a file at a line, a review of your changes, worktree notes, checkpoints and their diffs, your branch's pull request and CI, vulnerability reports and Dependabot alerts, asking the user to approve an automation script you wrote, forwarding or opening a port, creating, running commands on, or deleting cloud machines, remote control from a phone, listing or focusing the app's windows and tabs, waiting for a tab to close or the user's notes, Herdr UI settings, themes, and fonts, and keeping the machine awake.

availableCommands.name: parallel-slices
availableCommands.description: Plan, dispatch, integrate, and refine parallel text-only code generation with focused context and explicit file interfaces. Use when the user wants a batch of independent code-generation slices, or to repeat or improve a previous slice-generation run. Workers return text, not autonomous tool-using agents.

availableCommands.name: run-workflow
availableCommands.description: How to write and run a dynamic workflow script with the `run_workflow` tool: a Python script that orchestrates many agents with `agent`, `parallel`, `pipeline`, and `phase`. Use when a task splits into many independent or staged pieces of agent work (fan out over files, modules, bugs, or review angles, then aggregate), or when the user asks for a workflow. Don't use for a single delegated task (use a subagent) or for legacy workflow files (see migrate-workflows).

availableCommands.name: swarm
availableCommands.description: (Preview & Quota Heavy) Run a swarm: several agents working in parallel on one task, each in its own conversation, collaborating through a shared message board. Use when the work splits into pieces that can be done at the same time, or when a second pair of eyes should check the first pair's work.

availableCommands.name: terminal-browser
availableCommands.description: A real browser running inside the terminal. It splits the human's terminal pane automatically, so you can show a website side by side with the conversation, render HTML to visualize something, and drive whatever tab is open — snapshot, click, fill, eval — with the `terminal-browser action` subcommand.

availableCommands.description: 用百炼 CLI (`bl`) 走完"数据→微调训练→导出→部署→调用"的完整闭环，或跳过训练直接部署基座模型。支持文本模型（SFT/DPO/CPT）、音频 TTS 模型（CosyVoice）、图像生成模型（Wan2.7）和视频生成模型（Wan i2v/kf2v）微调。涵盖数据集校验/上传、创建微调任务、等待训练、导出最佳 checkpoint、创建推理部署、等待就绪、给出调用示例。当用户提到在百炼 / DashScope / 阿里云模型工作室上"训练模型""微调""fine-tune""finetune""部署模型""模型上线""把微调模型跑起来/调用""训练一个推理模型""继续预训练""LoRA/SFT/DPO 训练""语音合成模型""TTS 微调""CosyVoice""声音克隆""图像生成微调""文生图""图生图""Wan2.7""图像模型训练""视频生成微调""图生视频""首帧生视频""首尾帧""kf2v""i2v""Wan视频""视频特效训练"等，都应激活本技能——即使用户没明说"用 bl"，只要意图是百炼平台的训练或部署，就用本技能，不要自己拼凑命令。

availableCommands.name: graphify
availableCommands.description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

availableCommands.name: herdr-gpui-browser
availableCommands.description: Open a browser tab in Herdr UI beside your terminal to show the user a web page, HTML file, or mockup, and get back their notes and picks. Use it inside Herdr (HERDR_ENV=1) when the user asks to open, start, or show a browser tab, page, preview, or mockup, to explain, demo, or visualize how something works, or to mock up UI variants to pick from; prefer it there over other browser skills, a system browser, or long text explanations. Also use it for what Herdr UI, not the herdr daemon, shows or keeps: a file at a line, a review of your changes, worktree notes, checkpoints and their diffs, your branch's pull request and CI, vulnerability reports and Dependabot alerts, asking the user to approve an automation script you wrote, forwarding or opening a port, creating, running commands on, or deleting cloud machines, remote control from a phone, listing or focusing the app's windows and tabs, waiting for a tab to close or the user's notes, Herdr UI settings, themes, and fonts, and keeping the machine awake.

availableCommands.name: parallel-slices
availableCommands.description: Plan, dispatch, integrate, and refine parallel text-only code generation with focused context and explicit file interfaces. Use when the user wants a batch of independent code-generation slices, or to repeat or improve a previous slice-generation run. Workers return text, not autonomous tool-using agents.

availableCommands.name: run-workflow
availableCommands.description: How to write and run a dynamic workflow script with the `run_workflow` tool: a Python script that orchestrates many agents with `agent`, `parallel`, `pipeline`, and `phase`. Use when a task splits into many independent or staged pieces of agent work (fan out over files, modules, bugs, or review angles, then aggregate), or when the user asks for a workflow. Don't use for a single delegated task (use a subagent) or for legacy workflow files (see migrate-workflows).

availableCommands.name: swarm
availableCommands.description: (Preview & Quota Heavy) Run a swarm: several agents working in parallel on one task, each in its own conversation, collaborating through a shared message board. Use when the work splits into pieces that can be done at the same time, or when a second pair of eyes should check the first pair's work.

availableCommands.name: terminal-browser
availableCommands.description: A real browser running inside the terminal. It splits the human's terminal pane automatically, so you can show a website side by side with the conversation, render HTML to visualize something, and drive whatever tab is open — snapshot, click, fill, eval — with the `terminal-browser action` subcommand.

Target structure requires strict use of tilde code fences rather than backticks. Adding navigation state variables to `TabEntry` requires ensuring the derive macro handles the new fields cleanly. Initial assumption assumed `y` and `Y` shared identical copy behavior, but specification distinguishes between single-line/range extraction versus full-tab extraction. Adjusting `y` to evaluate visual mode state for targeted text retrieval while `Y` retains full tab dumping.

Plain text extraction must strip all visual artifacts like ANSI codes, line numbers, and gutter spacing. Mapping source lines directly to copy units ensures wrapped segments resolve back to their exact unformatted source lines joined by newline characters.

Tracing row-based copy range extraction against wrapped visual lines exposes a gap where selecting a middle wrapped segment advances the jump index past the target end boundary, prematurely terminating extraction. Adjusting the range traversal logic to handle partial unit intersections ensures wrapped text segments accurately contribute their source content.

Simulating extraction across wrapped text boundaries validates that partial unit intersections correctly recover full source lines without duplication. Handling empty artifacts by returning unchanged state preserves alignment with existing selection mechanics.

Examining the JSON output tab behavior reveals a conflict between the existing test suite and the new specification regarding keybindings. Existing tests assert that lowercase copy retrieves the raw JSON value, whereas the new requirement dictates it should copy the current visual line while uppercase retrieves the raw JSON. Resolving this discrepancy requires updating the existing test assertions to match the newly defined distinction.

Updating JSON tab tests to reflect the new keymap contract where lowercase copy retrieves visual lines and uppercase copy retrieves raw payloads. Verifying existing helpers still pass while expanding test coverage to validate both extraction behaviors.

Tab switching key handlers require clearing visual selection state and clamping cursors to valid row boundaries. Preserving existing change tracking return values ensures compatibility with current test assertions while correctly resetting navigation states.

Half-page vertical jumps require calculating scroll bounds based on active body height. Implementing boundary navigation keys resets viewport offsets and clamp indices to maximum visual limits, returning appropriate mutation states.

Keymap expansions map bracket keys to navigation outcomes and 'w' to toggle text wrapping, necessitating coordinate clamping and viewport readjustment upon wrap state changes. Preserving public scroll functions maintains compatibility with mouse wheel handlers and external test suites.

Cursor movement calculations require checking visual line limits to prevent out-of-bounds indexing. Clamping target rows against maximum boundaries and updating scroll offsets guarantees correct viewport tracking upon navigation.

Testing alternative scroll states reveals that resetting a non-zero viewport offset while the cursor is already at zero correctly triggers state mutation.

Tab switching handlers require checking emptiness incorrectly via `is_empty()` rather than negation, risking skipped execution. Correcting the conditional check ensures tab traversal properly resets visual anchors and adjusts active indices.

Reviewing tab switch implementation reveals a redundant anchor reset on the active index before reassigning it. Adjusting the flow ensures anchor clearing happens on the newly resolved tab after index mutation.

Clamping cursor and visual anchor positions against maximum visual boundaries ensures out-of-bounds prevention prior to range calculation. Computing selected line ranges allows row iteration loops to accurately evaluate selection status per rendered index.

Highlighting only text cells leaves unrendered padding unstyled. Filling the full horizontal row span with the highlight background ensures a clean visual bar and satisfies cell buffer test assertions.

Ensuring buffer cell modifications remain panic-free across arbitrary dimensions confirms that full-row background painting correctly covers gutters and text without clipping artifacts. Updating shortcut displays and modal definitions to reflect the revised navigation keymap aligns UI metadata with implemented interaction rules.

Shortcut metadata providers across inspector states require alignment with updated keymap definitions. Inspecting shortcut label methods reveals discrepancies where specific navigation keys and replay flags need explicit inclusion to match the implemented action bindings.

Inspecting `active_shortcut_labels` reveals that `Mode::Step` already correctly delegates shortcut generation, rendering edits to that function unnecessary. This leaves step-mode key handling as the primary target for navigation updates.

Inspecting step key handling logic confirms that navigation outcomes and replay actions are already completely wired. Reviewing modal shortcut definitions reveals that boundary keys for step navigation require updating to match the expanded keymap contract.
Modal shortcut labels align with specification entries, but test suites require verification. Cell background assertions depend on buffer cell accessibility methods to inspect rendered styling.

Testing multi-line copy behaviors confirms `Y` extracts full payloads while `y` targets individual lines. Updating JSON tab tests validates that raw payload extraction correctly maps to uppercase triggers while visual lines map to lowercase.

Writing comprehensive test suites for cursor movement, scroll following, visual range selection, escape unwinding, and wrapped line copy behavior. Validating viewport clamping limits, scroll offset adjustments, escape key cascade logic, and unformatted source line extraction across narrow text buffers.

Testing cell-level styling shifts across cursor movements confirms that background highlights correctly track row indices. Validating multi-line visual ranges and JSON copy distinctions ensures lowercase and uppercase operations isolate wrapped source boundaries and raw payloads as specified.

Testing row-based highlight positioning against centered viewports requires verifying relative highlight offsets rather than absolute coordinates to prevent brittleness from vertical offset calculations. Validating modal step-mode arrow key navigation confirms that horizontal movement mappings coexist with step transitions without breaking horizontal scrolling behavior under disabled text wrapping.

Coordinator directives mandate verifying external test suites for horizontal scroll key changes and shortcut string updates. Reviewing module edits confirms all state structures, visual layout helpers, selection ranges, and modal step key bindings integrate cleanly across the codebase.

Reviewing compilation and linter constraints confirms that all newly introduced layout helpers, selection methods, and navigation structures are fully consumed across key handlers and rendering loops. Verifying that no dead code or unhandled warnings remain guarantees compliance with strict build requirements.

Verifying framework version compatibility for buffer cell mutations and background styling methods. `buf.set_style` combined with buffer indexing ensures version-safe rendering and reliable test assertions for row highlights without triggering compilation errors.

Rendering execution confirms full-row background fills correctly paint across gutters, text, and trailing spaces using theme highlights. Boundary verification inside the layout rendering loop guarantees that cursor and visual anchor clamping handles zero-length visual states safely without integer underflows.
